issues.jp_before: 台所[だいどころ]{で|de-place}お湯[ゆ]{が|ga-subject}わいています。
issues.problem: With definite 'The water', お湯は (answering 'is the water boiling?') was a tenable reading, so the は distractor was not plainly wrong.
issues.action: Added あ、 to frame it as a newly noticed event; English 'Oh, the water's boiling in the kitchen.'

issues.jp_before: 玄関[げんかん]{に|ni-location}知[し]らない靴[くつ]{が|ga-existence}あります。
issues.problem: English 'a pair of shoes I don't know' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'There are some shoes I don't recognise at the front door.'

issues.jp_before: 父[ちち]{は|wa-topic}英語[えいご]{が|ga-stative}少[すこ]し分[わ]かります。
issues.problem: 英語は少し分かります is an everyday natural phrasing, so the は distractor was acceptable with the given English.
issues.action: Rewrote to 英語がよく分かります / 'My father understands English well.'

issues.jp_before: 朝[あさ]ご飯[はん]{は|wa-topic}いつも母[はは]{が|ga-subject}用意[ようい]します。
issues.problem: Near-duplicate of 洗濯はいつも母がします (same frame, same doer, same いつも).
issues.action: Rewrote to お弁当はいつも父が用意します / 'Father always prepares the packed lunches.' and adjusted why.

issues.jp_before: 土曜日[どようび]{は|wa-topic}会社[かいしゃ]{に|ni-destination}行[い]きません。
issues.problem: Non-focus destination slot missing equally natural alternative へ.

issues.jp_before: 週末[しゅうまつ]{は|wa-topic}家族[かぞく]{と|to-with}公園[こうえん]{に|ni-destination}行[い]きます。
issues.problem: Non-focus destination slot missing equally natural alternative へ.

issues.jp_before: 夜[よる]{は|wa-topic}あまりテレビ{を|o-object}見[み]ません。

issues.problem: Object of a negative verb: 洗濯はしません is equally natural; alternative missing.
